text:
Mia (AE): Quick sync — AcmeCorp RFP. Uploaded a first-pass capability_matrix_v3.xlsx and the blank security_questionnaire.pdf. Need technical responses + pricing for a 6–8 week POC. Main ask: SSO (SAML/SCIM), HSM-backed key management, EU-only data residency, and audit log retention in FRA. Who can pick this up?
Jordan (SE): I'll take the RFI tech answers and SSO config. Added inline comments in the sheet. Two potential blockers: 1) customer insists on FIPS 140-2 HSM + on-prem KMS, 2) wants private deployment with no egress. Need infra confirm.
Alex (Security): We support KMS integrations for Private deployments. Hosted supports customer-managed keys via dedicated VPC + cloud KMS; full HSM peering requires Private/on-prem. I'll draft the compliance note and cert matrix.
Sam (Solutions): POC pricing draft added to the pricing tab. Ballpark: Dedicated pool (4x A10G equiv) = $5,200/mo committed; burst to 8 GPUs at $0.85/hr. Recommend offering 50% credit for 6-week POC. I'll attach a simple line-item table.
Pat (Sales Eng): Action items: 1) @Jordan prepare SAML metadata + sample attribute mapping. 2) @Alex produce HSM/compliance note + required SLAs. 3) @Sam finalize POC pricing sheet and one-page cost summary. 4) @Mia confirm DPA and data residency language with Legal.
Jordan (SE): SAML config snippet (paste into their IdP):
```
EntityID: https://acme.example.com/
AssertionConsumerService: https://acme.redwood.ai/saml/acs
Attributes: email, displayName, groups
NameIDFormat: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
```
Jordan (SE): Note — For SCIM provisioning we support user/group sync via SCIM v2.0; need a service account from them and a DN for group mapping.
Alex (Security): For HSM: customer wants FIPS 140-2 Level 2+ with HSM HSM-VendorX. Our Private package can integrate via PKCS#11. We can't do HSM peering on Hosted without Private. I'll attach a short caveat paragraph to the RFI.
Mia (AE): Uploaded the filled security_questionnaire_filled.pdf (initial draft). Also added a notes tab in the spreadsheet for legal questions.
procurement-bot: Reminder — RFP due Friday 2026-04-03 17:00 UTC. Please attach final docs to the RFP portal.
Sam (Solutions): Question — can we propose EU-only logging/metrics? Customer requires logs not leave EU. @Alex, is that doable on Hosted in FRA?
Alex (Security): Yes — we can configure log buckets and metrics collection to stay in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) for Private and Hosted EU region. Need to confirm retention window and support for customer-managed buckets.
Pat (Sales Eng): Heads up — Acme asked about offline model artifacts transfer for on-prem POC. That implies air-gapped transfer process. @Jordan can you propose a secure transfer flow and checksum procedure?
Jordan (SE): Proposed transfer flow: scp over a customer-controlled bastion, SHA256 checksums, signed manifest, and local load script. I'll paste a one-liner they can run.
Jordan (SE): ```curl -O https://files.redwood.ai/acme/poc-model.tar.gz && sha256sum poc-model.tar.gz```
Mia (AE): Let's aim to have first draft out EOD tomorrow. I'll own coordination with Legal. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Pat (Sales Eng): I'll prepare a short slide with the blockers and mitigation for the AE deck.
